steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. The two listings are identical on every point I could see:

| | Brackmoor Sound (a) | Ottervale Audio (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2, graphite | Same |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping, refund to original payment method | Same |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| In the box | Headphones, case, USB-C cable, 3.5 mm cable | Same |

Nothing on the pages gives a reason to prefer one seller. The rating and review count are exactly the same on both. That may mean the reviews are for the product as a whole and not for each seller, so they may say nothing about either seller's service.

Some things could still differ, and the pages don't show them:
- **Seller reputation:** Search for independent reviews of Brackmoor Sound and Ottervale Audio. Look at how each handles shipping problems, returns and refunds.
- **Authenticity:** Check that each is an authorized Quellwyn reseller. That can affect whether the warranty is honored.
- **Total cost:** Look at checkout for taxes or fees that might differ. Neither page mentions any.

If checkout shows no difference, pick either one. I'd lean toward whichever seller has better independent reviews or is an authorized reseller.
